Hard line breaks rendered with backslash

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Line one<br>Line two</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(newline_style: 'Backslash'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
